questions.question: Before sailing for Syria, why did the apostle Paul have his head shaved in Cenchrea?

answers.text: To keep a vow he had made
To mark his last day in Corinth
To get ready for the long voyage

questions.question: When Paul left Ephesus, what condition did he give for coming back to the people there?

answers.text: If the synagogue writes to him
If the winds turn his way

questions.question: Apollos of Alexandria taught accurately about Jesus, but he knew only the baptism of which person?
When Priscilla and Aquila heard Apollos speak boldly in the synagogue at Ephesus, what did they do?

answers.text: Took him aside and explained the way of God more accurately
Corrected him right there in front of the whole synagogue
Told him to stop teaching until Paul came back
